background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the group, A+ on average and the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. The only ratio reported is leverage, at 7.5% in the top quarter of US banks, which is the one strength the figures can show. The flagged news, the newest on 6 Oct 2026, is a warning from its own leadership on rising cyber risk, alongside an SEC censure without a fine over supervision lapses; neither touches capital or funding.
